SELECT h.id AS hotelId, h.name AS hotelName, h.l_dong_signgu_cd AS lDongSignguCd, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.id) AS roomTypeCount, SUM(COALESCE(rti.total_inventory,0)) AS totalInventory, SUM(COALESCE(rti.total_reserved,0)) AS totalReserved, SUM(COALESCE(rti.total_inventory,0)-COALESCE(rti.total_reserved,0)) AS availableCount, CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(rti.total_inventory,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(rti.total_reserved) * 100.0 / SUM(rti.total_inventory),1) END AS reserveRate FROM hotel h LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON rt.hotel_id = h.id LEFT JOIN room_type_inventory rti ON rti.room_type_id = rt.id AND rti.date = #{date}
AND h.name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{hotelName},'%')
GROUP BY h.id
ORDER BY availableCount ASC
ORDER BY reserveRate DESC
ORDER BY reserveRate ASC
ORDER BY hotelName ASC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) FROM hotel h
AND h.name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{hotelName},'%')

SELECT rt.id AS room_type_id, rt.name AS room_type_name, rti.id AS inventory_id, rti.date AS date, rti.total_inventory AS total_inventory, rti.total_reserved AS total_reserved FROM room_type rt LEFT JOIN room_type_inventory rti ON rti.room_type_id = rt.id AND rti.date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE rt.hotel_id = #{hotelId} ORDER BY rt.id, rti.date
